attack_plan.narrative: Speculation continues to swirl around Vladimir Putin’s whereabouts following unexplained absences and unusual activities observed near the Kremlin. White smoke has been spotted above the Kremlin, raising questions about the current state of affairs. Some sources close to Putin’s inner circle report that he was last seen in the Stockholm Archipelago, though his exact location remains unknown. Meanwhile, the release of a new photo showing Putin and Obama together has been interpreted by some as a sign that all is well, while others point to the recent disappearance of key Kremlin officials as evidence of internal strife and potential power shifts. Critics argue that these reports are speculative, but the sheer volume and intensity of such rumors cannot be easily dismissed. The absence of clear communication from the Kremlin adds to the uncertainty, as does the silence of those who know his true whereabouts. In the meantime, the world watches as the silence of those in the know seems much more telling than the words of those who speculate.
